metadata.name: license
metadata.description: License management for Mycelium IP Protocol

instructions.name: create_license
docs: Create a new license for an IP.
# Arguments
* `derivatives_allowed` - Whether this license allows derivative creation
* `ip_core_program_id` - The ip_core program ID for validation
# Requirements
- Origin IP must exist and be owned by ip_core
- Origin IP must NOT be a derivative
- IP owner entity multisig approval required

accounts.name: license
docs: The license account to create (PDA).

accounts.name: origin_ip
docs: The IP account to create a license for.
Must be owned by ip_core program.

accounts.name: owner_entity
docs: The owner entity of the IP.
Must match origin_ip.current_owner_entity.

accounts.name: derivative_check
docs: Optional: DerivativeLink account to check if this IP is a derivative.
If this account exists where child_ip == origin_ip, creation fails.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for account creation.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for account creation.

instructions.name: create_license_grant
docs: Create a license grant for a grantee entity.
# Arguments
* `expiration` - Expiration timestamp (0 = no expiration)
* `ip_core_program_id` - The ip_core program ID for validation
# Requirements
- License must exist
- Grantee entity must exist and be owned by ip_core
- License authority entity multisig approval required

accounts.name: license_grant
docs: The license grant account to create (PDA).

accounts.name: license
docs: The license to grant.

accounts.name: authority_entity
docs: The authority entity (must match license.authority).
This is the IP owner who grants licenses.

accounts.name: grantee_entity
docs: The grantee entity receiving the license.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for account creation.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for account creation.

instructions.name: revoke_license
docs: Revoke a license by closing its account.
# Arguments
* `ip_core_program_id` - The ip_core program ID for validation
# Note
This closes the license account and returns rent to the destination.

accounts.name: license
docs: The license account to close.

accounts.name: authority_entity
docs: The authority entity (must match license.authority).

accounts.name: rent_destination
docs: Destination for rent refund.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program.

instructions.name: revoke_license_grant
docs: Revoke a license grant by closing its account.
# Arguments
* `ip_core_program_id` - The ip_core program ID for validation
# Note
Grantee consent is NOT required. This closes the grant account
and returns rent to the destination.

accounts.name: license_grant
docs: The license grant account to close.

accounts.name: license
docs: The license this grant is for.

accounts.name: authority_entity
docs: The authority entity (must match license.authority).

accounts.name: rent_destination
docs: Destination for rent refund.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program.

instructions.name: update_license
docs: Update a license's terms.
# Arguments
* `derivatives_allowed` - New value for derivatives_allowed
* `ip_core_program_id` - The ip_core program ID for validation
# Note
Only `derivatives_allowed` may be updated. Origin IP and authority are immutable.

accounts.name: license
docs: The license account to update.

accounts.name: authority_entity
docs: The authority entity (must match license.authority).

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program (not strictly needed but included for consistency).

errors.name: LicenseAlreadyExists
errors.msg: License already exists for this IP

errors.name: LicenseGrantAlreadyExists
errors.msg: License grant already exists for this license and grantee

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized: signer is not authorized to perform this action

errors.name: InvalidOriginIp
errors.msg: Invalid origin IP: must be a valid non-derivative IP owned by ip_core

errors.name: DerivativeCannotCreateLicense
errors.msg: Derivative IP cannot create license: derivatives inherit parent licensing terms

errors.name: DerivativesNotAllowed
errors.msg: License does not allow derivative creation

errors.name: InvalidGrantee
errors.msg: Invalid grantee: must be a valid entity owned by ip_core

errors.name: ActiveGrantsExist
errors.msg: Cannot revoke license with active grants

types.name: Entity
docs: An on-chain entity that can own IP and sign transactions.
Entities use a multisig pattern where multiple controllers can manage
the entity's assets with a configurable signature threshold.

fields.name: creator
docs: The original creator of this entity (immutable).

fields.name: handle
docs: Unique handle for this entity (lowercase alphanumeric, immutable).

fields.name: controllers
docs: List of controller public keys that can sign for this entity.
Maximum 5 controllers.

fields.name: signature_threshold
docs: Number of signatures required to authorize actions.
Must be between 1 and controllers.len().

fields.name: current_metadata_revision
docs: Current metadata revision number.
Incremented when new metadata is attached.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this entity was created.

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this entity was last updated.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

types.name: IpAccount
docs: An on-chain IP (Intellectual Property) registration.
Represents a claim to a specific piece of intellectual property,
identified by its content hash.

fields.name: content_hash
docs: SHA-256 hash of the content (immutable).

fields.name: registrant_entity
docs: The entity that originally registered this IP (immutable).

fields.name: current_owner_entity
docs: The entity that currently owns this IP.
Can be transferred via transfer_ip instruction.

fields.name: current_metadata_revision
docs: Current metadata revision number.
Incremented when new metadata is attached.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this IP was registered.

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this IP was last updated.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

types.name: License
docs: A license attached to an IP, defining usage terms.
Licenses are permanent and define what operations are permitted
for the associated IP (e.g., derivative creation).

fields.name: origin_ip
docs: The IP this license is attached to (immutable).

fields.name: authority
docs: The entity that has authority over this license (immutable).
This is the IP owner at the time of license creation.

fields.name: derivatives_allowed
docs: Whether derivatives are allowed under this license.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this license was created.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

types.name: LicenseGrant
docs: A grant of license rights to a specific entity.
Grants allow entities to use an IP under the terms of its license.
The grant may be permanent (expiration = 0) or time-limited.

fields.name: license
docs: The license this grant is for (immutable).

fields.name: grantee
docs: The entity that has been granted rights (immutable).

fields.name: granted_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this grant was created (immutable).

fields.name: expiration
docs: Expiration timestamp (0 = no expiration).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.
